name: Persistent Headache
desc: General guidance for head pressure or aches. Seek emergency care if accompanied by sudden numbness.

name: Shortness of Breath
desc: Difficulty breathing when resting requires immediate medical evaluation.

name: High Fever & Chills
desc: Common indicator of immune response. Monitor temperature and stay hydrated.

name: Persistent Abdominal Pain
desc: Localized severe pain should be evaluated by a healthcare specialist.

name: Skin Rash & Itching
desc: Evaluate localized skin changes, redness, or allergic flare-ups.

name: Redness / Eye Pressure
desc: Visual changes or persistent pain in the eye require professional examination.
